run_get_hf_models: run the script to fetch HuggingFace text-generation and conversational models and save them to text files
create_get_models: create a function that retrieves all models from a paginated HuggingFace API endpoint
create_get_next_url: create a function that extracts the next page URL from an HTTP Link header
create_get_cleaned_models: create a function that extracts model IDs from a list of HuggingFace model objects
create_write_to_txt: create a function that writes a list of model IDs to a plain text file
